:= by
  let F := CategoryTheory.forget₂ RingCat AddCommGrpCat
  let G := CategoryTheory.forget₂ RingCat CommMonCat

  have pres : CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesLimits F :=
    RingCat.forget₂AddCommGroup_preservesLimits

      CommMonCat.instIsRightAdjointForgetMonoidHomCarrier)

    (CategoryTheory.Forget₂.rightAdjointOfPreservesLimits G adjG)
